architecture: Cartesian transverse dual-polarization operator, ideal phase x shared aperture CNN
model_output: [Q,3,16] complex; equivalent two transverse polarizations; gain=sum(abs(Hw)^2)/(60*sum(abs(w)^2))
isolation: trainer only opens dev/train.npz and dev/validation.npz; reserved labels opened after selection freeze
historical_exposure: same complete HFSS table already used for diagnostics; holdout is prospective command/trajectory and internal angular-block generalization, not unseen physical state
hash_policy: no hashes per user; separate paths, fixed config, split intersection checks and freeze markers
operator_supervision: Shared direction-specific unit-complex gauge alignment across all Cartesian components and all 16 ports; relative phases retained
protocol_amendment: Before holdout opening: first development A run still improving at epoch 3000; extend every run cap to 6000 with the same 200-epoch/<0.03 dB early stop, as allowed by NEXT_OPTIMIZATION_PLAN P5.
